summary: BTCS Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on June 8, 2026. Shareholders voted on six proposals: election of three directors (Charles Allen, Charles Lee, Ashley DeSimone), ratification of Forvis Mazars as auditor, and amendments to the 2021 Equity Incentive Plan. All director nominees were elected, the auditor was ratified, and all plan amendments were approved. This is a routine shareholder meeting outcome with no special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. The filing is a standard Item 5.07 report.
